summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the grid EPC, transmission construction, and utility-services node. Quanta Services is the reference anchor because it is the dominant scaled listed contractor with record backlog, but the higher-priority discovery lane contains MYR Group, Primoris Services, and Preformed Line Products. MYR and Primoris are public specialty contractors with direct transmission, distribution, substation, and utility-services exposure. PLPC is a second-order hardware supplier whose formed-wire, connectors, spacers, dampers, insulators, and line-protection products can move ahead of visible construction revenue. Claims are research inputs only, not trading recommendations. Expanded the universe around the grid EPC and line-construction node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. The underfollowed lane points to MYR Group as a more focused electrical contractor, Preformed Line Products as the scarce transmission-line hardware proxy one step upstream of construction crews, and MasTec as a larger but still relevant power-delivery contractor with sizable backlog exposure. No buy/sell view is implied; these are research candidates for evidence follow-up. Expanded the universe around the grid EPC and line-construction execution layer with a two-lane funnel.
